item.title: Inland Mountain Shrines & Temples — Guide
item.description: Beyond the famous coast and Takachiho, the forested mountains of inland Miyazaki hold atmospheric shrines and temple complexes that offer a quiet, spiritual escape into nature. Set amid ancient cedars, mossy stone steps, streams and mountain scenery, these sacred sites carry a deep sense of age and tranquillity, reflecting the long-rooted local traditions of mountain worship that thread through this region. Weathered wooden halls, torii gates, guardian statues and secluded settings reward visitors who venture inland with a peaceful, contemplative atmosphere that changes beautifully with the seasons — fresh green in spring and summer, brilliant colour in autumn.
